motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the Controller be INSTRUCTED to transfer $290,000 within the Engineering Special Services Fund No. 682 Department No. 50, Revenue Source Code No. 4903, to a new account entitled Franklin Fields Bridge Repair for the Bureau of Engineering to complete the temporary repair of the Franklin Fields Bridge in Council District 6. • I FURTHER MOVE that the Board of Public Works, Bureau of Sanitation, Bureau of Engineering, Department of Recreation & Parks, and any other relevant City agency be INSTRUCTED to provide expedited review and permitting for the immediate installation of the temporary repair of the Franklin Fields Bridge. I FURTHER MOVE to AUTHORIZE the City Engineer, or designee, to make any necessary technical and/or accounting adjustments to the recommendations above to effectuate the intent o t ity Council action.
